discoveries.finding: Printify's mockup library for the current tote bag blank has no kid-appropriate lifestyle photography — every 'Person' mockup slot shows an adult model. The Halloween collection's gallery had to be built from product-only shots (front, back, size guide) instead of lifestyle imagery.
discoveries.relevance: Affects any future kids-focused collection using this same blank/provider. Consider evaluating alternate print providers with kid-model mockups, or budgeting for custom lifestyle photography, before the next kids-targeted launch.
discoveries.source: Full mockup library audit performed across all 5 Halloween listings, 2026-08-06.
